row: Founded in 2006, Long Island Rabbit Rescue Group is an all-volunteer organization based on Long Island, New York.  Our mission is to rescue abused, neglected or abandoned rabbits; have them medically treated and spayed/neutered; and place them in loving, indoor homes. We educate the public on the special care and health needs of domestic rabbits, and are sustained by your donations.
